description: This Swift source file defines the 'PhotoLibraryService' class, which provides functionality to fetch the latest photos from the device's photo library, resize them, encode them as JPEG, and return their metadata and base64 representations. The class manages payload size constraints to avoid exceeding WebSocket limits, handles photo authorization, and includes methods for image processing such as resizing and JPEG encoding under size constraints.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class that interacts with the iOS photo library to fetch, resize, and encode latest photos for external use.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the most recent photos from the photo library, respecting size and quality constraints, and returns them as a payload.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Generates a resized and JPEG-encoded payload for a given PHAsset, adhering to size and quality constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage as JPEG while ensuring the size does not exceed the specified base64 character budget, adjusting quality and size as needed.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
